ideas.title: Domino island
ideas.critique: A chain of rigid tiles that topple and pass their push on is physics the island has never had, and a wave crossing the whole island with friends dodging it is something people watch twice. Three hundred traced materials can turn into a showroom that hides the motion. If the tipping is keyframed rather than simulated, it is only a scripted scene. Gloop going off the pier is a stock ending.

ideas.title: I break the sound barrier
ideas.critique: A vapour cone and a shock ring that flattens grass and knocks friends over would be a new effect. The payoff, everyone sits down hard and a hat flies off, is the same Lumi-led gag shape the last posts already used. It lives or dies on whether the grass wave and the shock front really move as a simulation.

ideas.title: The island is a crumpled page
ideas.critique: This deforms the whole island again, after the seesaw and the dunes that buried the cottage, and friends slide into the low parts the same way. Having UVDoc flatten it 'a bit wrong' is the tool-misreads-it gag from 'We wrote PIE'. Only the creases are new.

ideas.title: Somebody got painted out
ideas.critique: Friends talking to a shimmering hole is an eerie picture, and editing a film with an ML model is a new form. The island changes in no way. It is a side-by-side post you watch once, and it again relies on a workshop model getting it slightly wrong.

ideas.title: Cold Mountain
ideas.critique: This is a scripted visit routine: friends come one at a time, say a line and leave puzzled, the same one-liner reaction the island has used many times. Text decals on rocks are labels, not interaction. The hermit mood is gentle, but nothing in it moves or plays.

ideas.title: The sea is a mirror
ideas.critique: A perfect mirror that shows an island that is not quite the same is a real path-tracing trick, and a moon at noon is a good wrong detail. A second altered island repeats the live mirror copy out at sea and the TV feedback. Unless the differences down there are alive, the camera pan is the only event.

ideas.title: Everybody walks on walls
ideas.critique: Gravity that changes direction per creature and per prop is a new way for things to move, and friends standing on the cottage wall is a picture people share. As pitched it is a one-minute rule acted out by the crowd and filmed, the form of the last four world-rule posts. Hats hanging the wrong way is the easy joke.

ideas.title: Shadow puppets on the cottage
ideas.critique: Friends forming a shape that turns into a dragon, a boat and Lumi repeats the cloud heart, fish and pig sequence, now in shadow. It also ends as a quiet light still, like 'Lit from below'. A low sun throwing real shadows is honest path-tracing work, but the picture is posed, not played.

ideas.title: A tree that grows from what you say
ideas.critique: Speech that turns into something growing on the island is the sand rule in a new costume. A procedural tree mesh is the only step, and the time-lapse film form has already been used for it.

ideas.title: I fall to pieces
ideas.critique: Lumi's own parts as rigid bodies that bounce and roll, plus a key to do it while playing, is real new physics on Lumi's own body, and putting Lumi back together wrong has replay value. It is another close Lumi body gag right after the jelly ball, and the mixed-parts payoff echoes the breeding pen. Scripted friend pickup would flatten it.
